name: Stoker Thermal Stomper
description: A heavy insulated boot built for workers in refrigerated facilities, cold-storage warehouses, and the brutal winters on the Shelf's exposed upper levels. Thick double-walled synthetic upper with a removable fleece liner, a wide platform sole for stability on ice, and a bright orange pull-loop at the heel. Not subtle, not light, not comfortable for walking more than a few blocks — but your toes stay alive at minus twenty. Well-worn pairs are a common sight on Tier 1 street corners in winter.
functionality: Thermal insulation rated to -25°C, ice-grip outsole, removable liner (washable)
what_it_says: You work cold storage or you live somewhere the heat cuts out. Warmth over everything.
story_hooks: The removable liner is sometimes used to conceal small items — warm, soft, and rarely checked at entry points.
A Shelf community that lost building heat for a winter hoards these — finding a stockpile might tell you who knew the heat was going to fail.

physical_description.visual_profile: A brutalist work boot with an imposing silhouette—wide, chunky, and aggressively functional. The bright orange pull-loop at the heel creates a visual anchor against dark synthetic materials. When worn, the wearer appears grounded and industrial, suggesting labor in extreme conditions.
physical_description.fit: Generous, roomy fit through the midfoot and toe box to accommodate thick socks and the removable fleece liner. The wide platform sole adds bulk and presents a stable, almost tank-like stance. Not designed for a sleek profile.
physical_description.primary_material: Double-walled synthetic upper (ballistic-grade polymer composite) with a rigid, textured exterior. Thick rubber platform sole with deep tread. Removable synthetic fleece liner for insulation.
physical_description.texture: Rough, industrial finish on the upper with visible seams and reinforcement stitching. The sole is heavily textured with aggressive grip patterns. The pull-loop is soft nylon webbing against hard synthetic shell.
physical_description.color_scheme: Charcoal grey or matte black synthetic upper with bright safety-orange nylon pull-loop at heel. Possibly weathered grey or tan edges where wear has abraded the coating.
physical_description.closures: Heavy-duty side zipper running from arch to mid-calf for quick on-and-off; reinforced with friction-fit grommet eyelets for traditional lacing as backup.
distinctive_features: Bright orange pull-loop—safety feature and only accent color
Extra-wide platform sole with ice-grip tread pattern
Stoker Industrial branding embossed on tongue
Common patina of salt stains and frost residue on well-worn pairs
physical_description.tier_indicator: Tier 3–4 functional workwear. Affordable mass-produced, not luxury, but durable enough to signal steady employment in industrial sectors.
physical_description.cultural_context: Worn by warehouse workers, cold-chain logistics personnel, maintenance crews on elevated industrial platforms, and winter-survival street dwellers. A practical choice that announces 'I work in the cold' rather than fashion awareness.
physical_description.condition_typical: Usually broken-in and weathered—salt-stained, scuffed, with visible creasing around the ankle. The orange loop may be faded or frayed from hard use. Fleece liner often dirty or compressed from repeated wear.
